Task 2 (6 points)
For items 1–6, read the text further and for each gap unscramble the word given in
CAPITAL LETTERS. There is an example at the beginning (0).
Cat Gatekeeper currently works with some of the most (0) ___________
0 POPULAR
(POLARUP) timewasters like TikTok and VK. The timer is customizable, but its
(1) ___________ (FAULTED) setting allots a (generous) 60 minutes of social media
frivolity. After overstepping your time limit, the screen is suddenly hijacked by a
very hefty tabby who promptly plops down in front of your browser (2) ___________
(OWNWID) for five minutes, preventing you from accessing your feed. After your
respite, the (3) ___________ (TAILIGD) feline presumably moves on to their next
distraction, thus letting you return to posting. Pretty simple stuff.
However, there is some leeway to Cat Gatekeeper. The (4) ___________
(MERIT) resets if you swap over to another website tab, and it’s exclusively
designed for the preset social media (5) ___________ (SALTPROMF). If that
sounds like an easy way to (6) ___________ (TEACH) the system—well, cats can’t
do everything for us, can they?
Task 3 (5 points)
For items 1–5, read the article up to the end and find 5 misspelled words and spell
them correctly. There is an example at the beginning (0).
0 TRUSTWORTHY
Cat Gatekeeper looks trastworthy from a security standpaint, too. The free extension
doesn’t feature ads, and promises that “no date is collected or transmitted externally.”
An independent review on Reddit also provided Cat Gatekeeper’s source code, which
only needs local storage permission to truck its own settings.
At any rate, it’s worth giving it a shoot. Cat Gatekeeper may not solve your social
media dependancy, but it might at least force you to break up with a brief “cat nap,”
so to speak.
